description: Update an issue: change status (move on the board), priority, assignee, labels, milestone, title or description. Pass milestone_id "" to clear. due_date (YYYY-MM-DD) sets the deadline.

assignee.description: a member name (see list_members) or "me" (notifies that person unless it is you); other text = free-text assignee; "" clears

client.description: client name or id for this issue only; "" or null = back to the project's client

due_date.description: due date YYYY-MM-DD; "" or null clears it

fields.description: set custom fields (see list_fields): { "Field name": value }; null or "" clears one

labels.description: the whole list of labels, e.g. ["bug", "mobile"]; replaces the current ones

priority.description: urgent, high, medium, low or none

start_date.description: planned start YYYY-MM-DD; "" or null clears it

status.description: one of the 6 kinds backlog, todo, in_progress, in_review, done, canceled, or the NAME of one of the project's own statuses (get_project -> statuses); a kind picks the first own status of that kind

title.description: short title, e.g. "Fix the checkout button on mobile"

name: update_issue
